title: Neon Snake
tagline: Eat the light. Don't eat yourself.
description: The arcade classic with a hard edge: the grid speeds up with every pellet, and the walls wrap straight into your own tail. Every fourth pellet drops a gold one worth three points — it expires, so it is always a gamble. Your best run is kept between sessions.
author: HexCave
howToPlay: Steer with the arrow keys or WASD. On a touch screen, swipe in the direction you want to turn.
Eat the pink pellet to grow by one segment and score a point.
Every fourth pellet drops a gold one worth three points — it disappears after six seconds, so it is always a gamble.
The walls wrap: leaving one edge brings you back in on the opposite side. Your own tail does not wrap, and touching it ends the run.
The grid speeds up with every pellet eaten, so a long run gets harder on its own.
Press space to pause, and again to resume.
goal: Eat as many pellets as you can without running into your own tail. Your best run is kept.

1.1.0.notes: Gold pellets: worth three points, gone in six seconds.
